amplihack copilot --allow-all-tools -p '# Step 2: Rewrite and Clarify Requirements
**Task Description:** Do a thorough debugging and usability pass on the employer-system app across BOTH branches: the SQLite main branch and the postgresql-version branch. Work on one branch at a time, committing separately so the two stay independent. Part 1 bug hunt on both branches: fix unsafe string-method calls on possibly null/undefined/number values, missing API try/catch or error responses, frontend fetch failure handling, import flow lookups and normalization, dashboard stats returning 0 incorrectly, report failures, pagination/search/filter bugs, blacklist cascade, and branch behavior inconsistencies. On postgresql-version also verify async/await correctness, query placeholder and boolean/date/result handling, and pool safety. Part 2 usability improvements on both branches: consistent list-page layout, search/filter/count/actions/empty/loading states, better form modals, company-first and company-filtered contact dropdowns, debounced search, sortable tables, pagination, FK names not IDs, consistent status badges, friendly errors, no white-screen page flash, button loading states, and accessibility labels/aria/focus. Keep security and business logic intact. Do not mix database implementations between branches. Test each branch so app starts, login works, CRUD works on all 9 entities, import works, and reports/dashboard load. Commit separately per branch and provide a short readable summary per branch.
**Initial Requirements:** 
Your role is to clarify and structure the task requirements.
**Actions Required:**
1. Identify explicit user requirements that CANNOT be optimized away
2. Remove ambiguity from the task description
3. Define clear success criteria
4. Document acceptance criteria
**Output Format:**
```json
{
  "task_summary": "one-line clear summary",
  "explicit_requirements": ["list of must-have features"],
  "acceptance_criteria": ["how to verify completion"],
  "out_of_scope": ["what this does NOT include"],
  "assumptions": ["assumptions being made"],
  "questions_resolved": ["clarifications made autonomously"],
  "estimated_complexity": "low/medium/high",
  "classification": "feature/bugfix/refactor/other"
}
```
Use your best judgment to work autonomously. Pass explicit requirements to ALL subsequent agents.


IMPORTANT: Proceed autonomously. Do not ask questions. Make reasonable decisions and continue.' --add-dir /projects/CRM_StudentAffaris
